trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task here. Work through the roadmap stages in order and use the checklist to see what is left. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and see it through to its end; it unlocks during normal story progress and cannot be missed. If you fail a section, the mission restarts from the last checkpoint. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Story chapters unlock in order, so keep playing the main missions marked on the map until the chapter closes. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Chapter trophies are unmissable: as long as you keep following the story missions, this pops when the chapter ends. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. You will reach it naturally by completing Chapters 1 and 2 first; there is no shortcut and nothing to prepare in advance. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so it pops late in a playthrough; keep the main missions as your priority if you want it quickly. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. It only becomes available after Chapter 4, so finish the chapters first and do not worry about it earlier. Before starting it, clear any missable trophies tied to earlier missions, since the finale closes the story. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Play and complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears on the map. Like all mission trophies it is unmissable, and a failed attempt restarts from a checkpoint. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions usually have a setup phase first, so follow the mission markers and finish the setup steps before the heist itself. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it unlocks. Mission trophies unlock in story order, so there is nothing extra to do beyond reaching it. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. If a mission step is unclear, follow the on-screen objective marker rather than wandering; the trophy pops the moment the mission ends. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Expect a combat-heavy mission; stock up on armour and ammo beforehand so a death does not cost you a retry. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the later named missions, so it arrives in the back half of the story; just keep playing the main missions in order. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which counts story missions, side strands, activities, collectibles and exploration together. This is the last gold most players earn: use the in-game stats screen to find which categories are incomplete, then clear them one by one. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Perform 250 stunts in total: jumps, near misses, long airtime and similar driving feats all count, and the counter keeps adding up across the whole game. A fast car and the airport runways or long jumps are the easiest places to farm them once the story is done. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once: racing, fishing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the other open-world activities the game lists. You do not need to win or finish any of them, just start each type once. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range has several challenges with a score target for gold, so learn one weapon's recoil at a time and retry a challenge until the gold threshold clears. This is the longest activity grind in the list, so spread it across the playthrough. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location hosts its own race; winning one marks that location done, so work through the map location by location and retry any race you lose. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across the game's race types. Each distinct race counts once, so enter new races instead of replaying one you already won. Street, off-road and water races all count toward the 20. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing challenge and beat his catch. Fishing challenges reward patience: watch the line tension, reel in steadily, and do not let the fish snap the line. You can retry the challenge if you lose. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Find an arcade machine in the open world, start any arcade game on it, and play it through to completion. You only need to finish one game, not beat a high score. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's stranger mission strand until his final mission appears, then complete it. Stranger strands unlock as you meet their characters in the open world, so explore and answer their calls when they come in. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand by completing his final mission. Keep an eye on the map for his stranger marker after each of his earlier missions. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand by completing his final mission. Stranger strands are optional side content, so they never block the story, but they do count toward 100% completion. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Each strand is a short chain of missions for one stranger character; finishing a strand's final mission counts one toward the eight. Meet strangers by exploring and following their map markers. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand by completing his final mission. If a strand seems stalled, keep playing the story: later strands often unlock only after certain chapters. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand by completing his final mission. His strand is one of the eight that counts toward Strangers & Freaks, so it does double duty. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find and meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic places, often on hilltops, beaches and overlooks; the game marks a spot used once you meditate there. Work through them region by region. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take on Bret's hunting request and track down the unique animal he wants. Unique animals appear in specific habitats, so follow Bret's clues about where it roams and approach quietly with a suitable weapon. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Collect enough cards to complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida in shops, interiors and out-of-the-way spots; each set needs every card in it, so track which sets are closest to done and hunt their missing cards last. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. Each new location counts once, so keep moving: the counter rewards coverage of the map, not repeats at the same spot. This pairs well with exploring all 52 areas. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's challenges, the small open-world tasks tracked in the challenges menu. They span driving, combat, exploration and activities, so the counter climbs naturally; check the menu to see which types you have left. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, build your wanted level up to 4 stars, then lose the cops and escape. MISSABLE in the moment: it needs your partner present, so do it during a story segment or activity where your partner is with you, and break line of sight until the stars clear. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without the wanted level dropping in between. MISSABLE in the moment: plan a route with three close shops, keep the heat on between robberies, and do not let the cops lose you until the third is done. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by getting into them or spotting them in the world. Variety matters, not repeats: drive new models whenever you see them, and check the vehicle list to see what you still lack. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus when at least 5 enemies are close together, then take all 5 down before it ends. The easiest setup is a gang shootout or a wanted-level standoff where enemies bunch up; save it for a crowded fight rather than a lone target. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, leave by an unscheduled route instead of the normal exits: take an aircraft or slip out through a restricted area. MISSABLE in the moment: it needs the airport setting, so attempt it while a mission or activity has you at VCIA rather than hoping to stumble on it later. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhino tanks: get into a Rhino or survive an encounter with them. MISSABLE in the moment: Rhinos appear in specific military or high-wanted situations, so take the chance when tanks show up rather than passing it by. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without any detection: go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards spotting you, and get out before an alarm. MISSABLE per attempt, not per playthrough: if you are spotted, leave and try the robbery again cleanly. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the bigger heist-style robberies, so plan each with a fast getaway car and an escape route; the counter keeps your progress across attempts. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, rob it, and escape with the cash. Armored trucks patrol set routes, so watch for one, stop it, take the money and lose any wanted level that follows. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida. The in-game map tracks which areas you have been to, so drive through uncovered regions and check the stats screen for the ones still missing. This pairs naturally with the WAiNK It and meditation hunts. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own operations, so you will need to find all nine gangs' turf and hit one operation per gang; the game tracks which gangs you have covered. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail at a beachfront spot, and enjoy the view. MISSABLE in the moment: it is a specific one-off interaction at a specific place, so do it when you are at Ocean Beach rather than leaving it for later. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle straight through a showroom's glass front and out onto the street. MISSABLE in the moment: pick a showroom, build a little speed inside, and smash out in one run. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on a bowling game there. MISSABLE in the moment: it is tied to that one alley, so bowl there when you pass it rather than at any other lane. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Reach a partnership moment with mass appeal, the story beat where your partnership becomes public. MISSABLE in the moment: it is tied to a specific story scene, so it pops during that scene and cannot be redone except by replaying the mission. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Make 500 choices across the game: dialogue picks, activity choices and the small decisions the game tracks all add up. MISSABLE in the sense that some choices only appear once, so pick actively during story scenes instead of skipping dialogue; the counter is cumulative. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try at something you failed once. MISSABLE in the moment: it needs a failed attempt followed by a success, so when you fail a challenge or mission section, retry it right away and finish it. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Witness one of Leonida's strange random events, the odd encounters that happen out in the world. MISSABLE in the moment: these events are rare and unmarked, so explore side roads and odd locations and take a look when something unusual happens. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, a drive-by with a bat or similar weapon. MISSABLE per attempt: line up a slow pass past a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and retry if you miss. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; pass them to your laundering contacts over time until the total reaches $250,000. It is a slow earner, so start early and keep feeding it. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops: clothes, weapons, food, vehicle upgrades and everything else counts. Big purchases like cars and weapon mods move the counter fastest, so save the expensive shopping for this trophy. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Garages cost serious money, so this is a late-game purchase once your laundering and robbery income is flowing; check the property listings to find the ones you have not bought yet. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles in the world, then register each one through the app; the counter keeps your progress, so add vehicles as you discover them. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation); Exophase GTA VI trophy list
